It's for researchers, writers, and analysts who want AI output to be verifiable.

item.description: OpenKAL defines a generic kernel-interface layer for C++ so it can cross-compile between Windows, Linux, and macOS — e.g., building Linux/macOS binaries from Windows. The project is on GitHub with the openkal spec, the mcpp build tool, and cross-build examples. It's useful for developers who need multi-platform C++ outputs without juggling separate toolchains.

item.title: [infoq] Cloudflare 推出 Agent Tracing：支持截断限制，不同框架的 Payload 默认记录策略存在差异
item.description: Cloudflare launched Agent Tracing, the first component of Cloudflare Agents, adding a unified dashboard for agent sessions. It extends Workers Tracing with agent-level spans for agent invocations, model calls, tool executions, and approvals, carrying model info and token usage; subagent work nests under the parent flow. Free in beta, it enters Workers Observability billing on October 1, 2026, and helps debug agents that return HTTP 200 yet misbehave through wrong tool choices or costly retries.

item.title: [infoq] npm 终于动手了：默认封杀 postinstall 脚本
item.description: npm 12 ships with allowScripts disabled by default, so preinstall, install, and postinstall scripts from dependencies (including implicit node-gyp builds) won't run unless explicitly approved. It also defaults --allow-git and --allow-remote to none and deprecates fine-grained access tokens that could bypass 2FA. The npm team provides a migration guide; the community response is largely supportive.

item.title: [infoq] Cloudflare 推出 Cache Response Rules，在源站响应后进一步控制缓存
item.description: Cloudflare has launched Cache Response Rules, a new rule engine that runs after the origin responds but before content is written to cache. It lets you adjust Cache-Control directives, manage cache tags, and strip headers like Set-Cookie, ETag, or Last-Modified without modifying your origin app. Cloudflare says it complements, not replaces, existing Cache Rules and can boost cache hit rates and ease CDN migrations.

item.title: [infoq] 向量数据库要被取代？DynamoDB 开始原生支持 AI 搜索
item.description: DynamoDB now has native vector search: embeddings and application data can live in the same table, and developers query them via the SearchVectors API for approximate nearest neighbors, eliminating a separate vector database. It scales serverlessly, supports up to 4,096 dimensions and several distance functions, and can reach trillions of vectors with single-digit-millisecond latency; costs are metered for index writes, queries, and storage.

item.description: Amazon has open-sourced Dogwood, a policy language for AI-agent tool calls that can read an agent’s event history and express temporal constraints, complementing the stateless Cedar. It adds operators such as formerly and sum_within for sequence-level rules, and demonstrates a classic pitfall where rate limits on responses are bypassed by concurrent transfers. A good fit for teams building deterministic guardrails around agent tools.

item.title: [juejin] 一键还原任意网站，这套 Playwright + 多 Agent 工程流太猛了
item.description: ai-website-cloner-template is a Claude Code-based workflow for cloning websites. It uses Playwright to capture screenshots at three viewports (1440×900, 768×1024, 390×844), extracts computed design tokens via getComputedStyle(), and simulates scrolls, clicks, and hovers before generating code. In a test on juejin.cn, mobile adaptation was solid and UI fidelity exceeded 70%. Frontend developers who need a rapid way to convert live sites into maintainable code can use it.
